About the portal

The University of Engineering and Technology Mardan (UET Mardan) was established on 7 March 2018 by the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under the KP Universities Act. The campus is on Charsadda Road, Mardan, and covers 172 kanals. It has been running since 2002, first as a satellite campus of UET Peshawar.

The university is recognized by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) and the Higher Education Commission (HEC).

Events

Events at UET Mardan. Pick one and register below.

National Outreach Program for Faculty

A 20-day training program for 30 UET Mardan faculty members, from 24 April to 20 May 2026. Nine modules cover teaching, research skills and academic leadership.

Anti-Drug Awareness Seminar

An awareness seminar held with the Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF), the Higher Education Regulatory Authority (HERA) and the Anti-Counter Violence and Extremism Department.

Professional Development and Career Counseling

Organized by ORIC. Covers building a professional profile, skills for global markets, and freelancing on Fiverr, Upwork and Freelancer.

Youm-e-Istehsaal Kashmir

A solidarity walk organized by the Director of Clubs and Societies, with the Registrar, faculty and students, and a minute of silence for the victims.

              <div class="form-check form-check-inline">
